answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent identity to a remotely verified enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE) and a hardware-protected signing key, not merely to a copyable software image. With provisioning limited to one credential per enclave, duplicating a VM or disk cannot reproduce that key or mint another identity. Expanding the identity pool therefore requires additional attested physical capacity, rather than cheap VM copies scattered across a marble grove or tundra of hosts.
